title: APRSAF Poster Contest
text:
APRSAF Poster Contest
The APRSAF Space Education for All Working Group (SE4AWG) successfully held the APRSAF-31 Poster Contest Online Award Ceremony on 8 March 2026.

title: APRSAF Award Nominations Have Closed
text:
APRSAF Award Nominations Have Closed
Thank you to everyone who submitted nominations for the APRSAF Awards.

title: Registration for APRSAF-32 is officially open
text:
Registration for APRSAF-32 is officially open
Registration for the 32nd session of the Asia-Pacific Regional Space Agency Forum (APRSAF-32) in Bangkok, Thailand is now open!

title: Still open for nominations
text:
Still open for nominations
Only 4 weeks left until the deadline, 30th June 2026! We are still open for the APRSAF Awards nominations and would love to hear from you.

title: 🚀 APRSAF-32 First Announcement Released
text:
🚀 APRSAF-32 First Announcement Released
We are pleased to announce that the first announcement of the 32nd session of the Asia-Pacific Regional Space Agency Forum (APRSAF-32) has been officially released.

title: 🏆 Call for Nominations: 2026 APRSAF Awards
text:
🏆 Call for Nominations: 2026 APRSAF Awards
We are pleased to announce that nominations for the 2026 APRSAF Awards are now open! 🚀

title: 🚀 Preparation for APRSAF-32 has officially begun!
text:
🚀 Preparation for APRSAF-32 has officially begun!
The First ExCom Meeting was successfully held, marking the first step toward this year’s forum.
